title: Homonormativity, Homonationalism, and Pinkwashing in “Heated Rivalry”
author: Ian Barnard
content:
Amidst all the celebratory brouhaha around HBO’s megasuccsssful queer hockey
streaming series Heated Rivalry, I feel called upon to be the party pooper. As
a queer English professor who works in queer theory, I see two related
concepts developed by queer theorists and activists as offering vital
interventions into the dominant discourse around Heated Rivalry: […]
